messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Elevated 5xx rate for eu-west1->us-central1 cross-region routes. Metric: request_error_rate 7.8% (baseline 0.3%). Affected prefix: /api/generate. Pager: oncall@sarah.

sarah (oncall): seeing it, paging neteng and sre. I'm grabbing logs now.

miguel (neteng): looking. initial hypothesis: cross-region fanout/backpressure causing routing fallbacks to untested pools. Checking steering policy logs.

alice (sre): can you confirm if DNS pins were recently changed? also any config rollouts in last hour? I see a small surge in queue depth on eu-west1 workers.

miguel (neteng): no config rollouts from neteng. But control-plane shows many pin override events around ts 1692104200.

devops-bot: Deploy bot: rollout/steering-policy-v2 started by jordan at 1692104150, status: succeeded.

sarah (oncall): okay that matches timeline. Could the new steering rules be too aggressive and cause backpressure? If requests get bumped to us-central1 due to latency steering, capacity mismatch might cause errors.

jordan (prod-support): we pushed a latency-steering tweak for multi-region fanout optimization. It was intended to shift 20% out of eu-west1 under high latency. Maybe threshold was wrong.

alice (sre): for immediate mitigation propose: 1) pause the new steering policy 2) temporarily pin traffic to region eu-west1 for affected customer(s) 3) reduce DNS TTL to 30s to allow faster failback if needed.

miguel (neteng): agreed. I'm going to pause the steering policy now and re-evaluate routing tables.

miguel (neteng): paused steering policy rollout (steering-policy-v2) — command:
```
redwoodctl routing rollout pause steering-policy-v2 --reason "incident 1692104567"
```

incident-bot: Action logged. pause accepted by control plane.

sarah (oncall): applying temporary pin for /api/generate from eu-west1 -> override weight to 95%.

miguel (neteng): pin applied. config snippet:
```
routing.apply({
  prefix: "/api/generate",
  overrides: [{ region: "eu-west1", weight: 0.95 }],
  reason: "mitigation - incident 1692104567"
})
```

alice (sre): setting DNS TTL to 30s for eu->global record now.

devops-bot: DNS change submitted. Change ID: CHG-992233. Expected propagation ~ 30s after commit.

jordan (prod-support): heads up — customer impact: two Dedicated customers in EU reporting elevated errors, several hosted customers showing 5xx spikes. CS alerted.

emma (pm): flagging priority customer X, they reported degraded ingestion since ~1692104300. Do we have estimated affected request percentage?

alice (sre): quick query:
```
select count(*) filter (status >=500) / count(*) from request_metrics where prefix='/api/generate' and ts > 1692104200;
```
Result: ~6.3% of requests returning 5xx during peak window. Mostly from us-central1 fallback paths.

sarah (oncall): after pause+pin+dns adjustments, monitoring shows error rate dropping -> 0.9% within two minutes.

miguel (neteng): connection queue depth in us-central1 decreased, eu-west1 CPU/queue back to normal. Metrics: request latency stable.

jordan (prod-support): CS confirming decreased tickets; customer X acknowledges improvement. :thumbsup: 

sarah (oncall): marking incident as mitigated for now. keeping channel open for 2 hours of observation before declaring resolved.

alice (sre): follow-ups: 1) revert pin and test steering-policy-v2 in canary with tighter thresholds 2) postmortem owner: miguel + alice 3) run capacity simulation for fanout scenarios across regions.

miguel (neteng): assigning postmortem, will schedule blameless RCA. I'll collect steering telemetry and rollout diff.

jordan (prod-support): prepping customer-facing summary for impacted customers.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigated - error rate returned to baseline after mitigations. SLA impact window: 1692104200 - 1692104800. Severity: SEV2. Next steps: postmortem and config hardening.

sarah (oncall): thanks team. I'll handoff to daytime oncall in 45m for monitoring. If any regression, ping this thread.

miguel (neteng): adding config test and synthetic to catch this: will push alerts for cross-region fallback rate >1%.

alice (sre): note for postmortem: regression test to simulate capacity imbalance + steering-policy ramp.

emma (pm): will join postmortem to capture customer impact and roadmap changes.

sarah (oncall): closing live mitigation. moving to follow-up tracking: TICKET-INC-9823. :white_check_mark:
